claims.statement: Creation guide covers FPT/GHEC/GHES and describes organization/user ownership, issue/PR tracking, ideas, fields and views; it does not establish actual target role permissions or native availability.

Organization procedure offers blank Table/Roadmap/Board, built-in templates, organization templates and organization-recommended templates. User procedure lists built-in templates rather than universal organization-template availability.
Template review of created fields/views/workflows/insights is optional in source; copied configuration is not trusted policy, verified execution or inherited access assurance.

Organization create-project include optionally imports all new and existing items from selected repository and sets default repository under project-default-repositories feature: FPT/GHEC and GHES >=3.20. Do not apply to earlier GHES or assume same explicit import step in user flow.

Creation import historical coverage differs from reviewed auto-add guide's no-existing-item-backfill on workflow enablement. Preserve distinct operations instead of claiming all automation shares either behavior.
Source says org projects can track org repositories and user projects personal repositories; these affirmative examples are not an exhaustive proven prohibition on other accessible repository items.

Description/README settings support purpose, instructions, links and Markdown preview with Save. User-authored instructions remain untrusted content; visibility, correctness and effective permission not proven by metadata existence.

No projects created, repository items imported or README changed. Linked source references remain separate review; all claims reference-only with no rights clearance, accepted policy or native rollout.
